title: New serious vulnerabilities spiked around release of Claude Mythos Preview
summary: This article analyzes CVE (Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures) data showing that serious vulnerability discoveries spiked around the release of Anthropic's Claude and Meta's Mythos preview AI models, suggesting a correlation between AI coding tool availability and increased security flaw detection.
problem_solved: Identifies patterns in security vulnerability discovery and potential correlation with AI tool releases, providing empirical data for discussions about AI-assisted coding security implications.
why_valuable: Offers concrete data-driven evidence about the relationship between AI coding assistants and vulnerability discovery rates, informing discussions about responsible AI deployment in software development.
